governingFramework: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
source: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)

notes: Standard GST slabs (0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, 28%) established per CGST Act 2017 and updated via CBIC notifications. Intra-state supplies split equally into CGST and SGST; inter-state supplies apply full rate as IGST.
